entries.title: Ezekiel 7:1
segments: ¶Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:2
segments: "And you, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD to the land of Israel: 'An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:3
segments: Now the end [has come] upon you, And I will send My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways, And I will repay you for all your abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:4
segments: My eye will not spare you, Nor will I have pity; But I will repay your ways, And your abominations will be in your midst; Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD!'

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:5
segments: "Thus says the Lord GOD: 'A disaster, a singular disaster; Behold, it has come!

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:6
segments: An end has come, The end has come; It has dawned for you; Behold, it has come!

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:7
segments: Doom has come to you, you who dwell in the land; The time has come, A day of trouble [is] near, And not of rejoicing in the mountains.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:8
segments: Now upon you I will soon pour out My fury, And spend My anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, And I will repay you for all your abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:9
segments: 'My eye will not spare, Nor will I have pity; I will repay you according to your ways, And your abominations will be in your midst. Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD who strikes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:10
segments: 'Behold, the day! Behold, it has come! Doom has gone out; The rod has blossomed, Pride has budded.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:11
segments: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness; None of them [shall remain], None of their multitude, None of them; Nor [shall there be] wailing for them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:12
segments: The time has come, The day draws near. 'Let not the buyer rejoice, Nor the seller mourn, For wrath [is] on their whole multitude.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:13
segments: For the seller shall not return to what has been sold, Though he may still be alive; For the vision concerns the whole multitude, And it shall not turn back; No one will strengthen himself Who lives in iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:14
segments: 'They have blown the trumpet and made everyone ready, But no one goes to battle; For My wrath [is] on all their multitude.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:15
segments: The sword [is] outside, And the pestilence and famine within. Whoever [is] in the field Will die by the sword; And whoever [is] in the city, Famine and pestilence will devour him.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:16
segments: ¶'Those who survive will escape and be on the mountains Like doves of the valleys, All of them mourning, Each for his iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:17
segments: Every hand will be feeble, And every knee will be [as] weak [as] water.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:18
segments: They will also be girded with sackcloth; Horror will cover them; Shame [will be] on every face, Baldness on all their heads.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:19
segments: 'They will throw their silver into the streets, And their gold will be like refuse; Their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them In the day of the wrath of the LORD; They will not satisfy their souls, Nor fill their stomachs, Because it became their stumbling block of iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:20
segments: 'As for the beauty of his ornaments, He set it in majesty; But they made from it The images of their abominations-Their detestable things; Therefore I have made it Like refuse to them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:21
segments: I will give it as plunder Into the hands of strangers, And to the wicked of the earth as spoil; And they shall defile it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:22
segments: I will turn My face from them, And they will defile My secret place; For robbers shall enter it and defile it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:23
segments: ¶'Make a chain, For the land is filled with crimes of blood, And the city is full of violence.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:24
segments: Therefore I will bring the worst of the Gentiles, And they will possess their houses; I will cause the pomp of the strong to cease, And their holy places shall be defiled.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:25
segments: Destruction comes; They will seek peace, but [there shall be] none.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:26
segments: Disaster will come upon disaster, And rumor will be upon rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet; But the law will perish from the priest, And counsel from the elders.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:27
segments: 'The king will mourn, The prince will be clothed with desolation, And the hands of the common people will tremble. I will do to them according to their way, And according to what they deserve I will judge them; Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD!'"
